title: Honmaru area and palace — official castle

facts.fact: Hommaru Palace served the Owari Tokugawa residence and administration; rebuilt in2018 after wartime destruction, unlike the closed keep.
Main keep currently closed for ageing and earthquake-resistance concerns; never advertise climbing it.
facts.excerpt: closed due to age and earthquake resistance concerns.
